data.name: Little Library
data.detailed_description:
You have arrived in the quiet village of Maplewood with one goal: bring a brand-new library to life and help a struggling community find its footing again. Funding is limited and every decision matters. To keep the doors open, you will manage resources, grow the collection, and host events that draw the villagers together.

Life in Maplewood extends far beyond the library itself. You can tend a small farm, fish in local waters, explore the Whispering Woods, take part in community projects, and build meaningful relationships with the people who call this place home. From aspiring writers to seasoned travelers, every villager contributes to Maplewood’s revival. As you uncover pieces of the village’s forgotten past, you will shape the future that follows. The Folk Festival is approaching. Can you turn the library into the heart of the community before it arrives?

Features:

• Build and manage the library, growing it from a modest collection into a thriving community hub.

• Expand your shelves with more than 70 books, including rare and collectible titles that boost the library’s reputation.

• Tend a small farm to earn extra income, trade with villagers, and settle into rural life.

• Fish in ponds and lakes to gather resources, complete requests, and support your library work.

• Explore the Whispering Woods and discover the secrets hidden on the village outskirts.

• Uncover Maplewood’s history by expanding the Local History section and piecing together the past.

• Connect with the villagers, build friendships, and pursue romance as you become part of the community.

• Host book clubs and other events that bring the town together and strengthen the library’s role.

• Replay the story for new outcomes, with choices that influence relationships and the village’s future.

Can you build a library that endures and rekindle the spirit of Maplewood?

data.short_description: Run your own cozy village library. Recommend books to visitors based on their tastes, manage daily tasks, grow your collection, and build a thriving community around your library.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 8.1/10/11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL / VRAM 1GB or better
  • Storage: 900 MB available space
